subject: Confirmation of Hotel Reservation
body: Dear [Name], Thank you for choosing to stay with us at Bluewave Hotel. We are pleased to confirm your reservation for a deluxe room for two from June 15th to June 20th. Your booking includes complimentary breakfast and access to our pool and fitness center. Please let us know if you have any special requests or require airport transfer services. We look forward to welcoming you! Warm regards, The Bluewave Hotel Team
